ORDER 1 .
The petitioner is aggrieved by order dated 11/12/2023 (Annexure- P/1), whereby she was placed under suspension on account of certain financial irregularities mentioned in the order itself.
She has also challenged order dated 21/05/2024 (Annexure-P/2), whereby the appeal filed against the suspension order has been rejected by the Appellate Authority.
The petitioner has prayed for her restoration in the service.
2 . It is gathered from the records that the petitioner was working as Assistant Grade-II in the office of Block Education Officer, Lahar, District- Bhind (M.P.).
She was placed under suspension vide order dated 11/12/2023 on account of certain financial irregularities.
An FIR was also registered against the petitioner for the offence punishable under Sections 420 and 409 of IPC.

The petitioner has filed W.P. No.4757/2024 against the said FIR and NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:10726 2 WP-15344-2024 vide order dated 26/02/2024, this Court directed that no coercive action be taken against the petitioner.
The petition is pending.
3 . A charge-sheet was issued to the petitioner on 29/01/2024 (Annexure- P/12).

Allegations levelled against the petitioner is that while working as creator in the office of Block Development Education Officer, Lahar, District- Bhind, she unauthorizedly credited the amount in her own account.
The petitioner has submitted reply to the charge-sheet on 19/02/2024.
The enquiry is stated to be pending till date without any further progress.

sentences.text: The petitioner is under suspension since 11/12/2023.
Charge-sheet was issued on 29/01/2024 which is still pending.
Therefore, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of this writ petition directing the respondent authority to conclude the departmental enquiry within a fixed time.

5 . Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed off directing respondent no.6 to conclude the departmental enquiry issued pursuant to the charge- sheet dated 29/01/2024 within a period of four months from the date of submission of certified copy of this order.
6 . With the aforesaid direction, this writ petition is disposed off.
